reason: Three months free, setup done for me and nothing touches my POS - that's exactly how I like to try new tools. If the Keepz fee in writing beats my terminal and guests actually use the QR, 29 lari is nothing next to knowing who my regulars are.
objection: You're a new startup - if you fold in a year, I've trained staff on something dead and my guests got used to it. The export clause helps with the data, but I want to know who's behind this and what happens to the payments if you disappear.
would_change_my_mind: If the per-transaction fee in writing comes out higher than my card terminal, I'd stop after the free months.
